item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander ties Wilt Chamberlain’s record of 126 straight games with at least 20 points
item.description: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has tied Wilt Chamberlain’s record by scoring at least 20 points in 126 consecutive games. The Oklahoma City Thunder guard and reigning MVP hit a 3-pointer late in the third quarter Monday night against Denver to reach 22 points. Gilgeous-Alexander could break the record Thursday at home against the Boston Celtics. Chamberlain set the record from 1961 to 1963. item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander ties Wilt’s record and hits winning 3 as Thunder beat Nuggets 129-126
item.description: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander drilled a step-back 3-pointer with 2.7 seconds left to cap a frantic final minute on a night he matched Wilt Chamberlain’s record for consecutive 20-point games, and the Oklahoma City beat the Denver Nuggets 129-126. Gilgeous-Alexander finished with 35 points and a career-high 15 assists, becoming the second player in NBA history to have those totals and zero turnovers. He also had nine rebounds. item.title: US allies and rivals in Asia gauge fallout from war in the Middle East
item.description: North Korea, South Korea, Japan, and China are watching warily as war spreads across the Middle East. U.S. attacks on Iran are likely to reinforce North Korean leaders' belief that it was right to pursue nuclear weapons. Experts say a similar attack on Pyongyang looks far riskier. South Korea worries about oil shocks and any threat to the Strait of Hormuz. It also fears getting pulled into any potential U.S. military actions taken without close ally coordination. item.title: A Virginia boater is suing a Washington utility for the Potomac River sewage spill
item.description: A Virginia boater is suing DC Water, saying its negligence led to a massive sewage leak into the Potomac River. The class action complaint, filed Friday, argues the utility failed to keep its Potomac Interceptor pipe in a safe condition. The lawsuit targets damage tied to the January pipe collapse and spill. item.title: Trump pushes GOP on voting bill, demanding an end to most mail balloting
item.description: President Donald Trump says he won’t sign any other legislation into law until Congress passes a strict proof-of-citizenship voting bill that he says also must end Americans’ ability to vote by mail. It's a startling demand months before the midterm elections. Trump told House Republicans during their annual retreat at his golf club in Florida that he doesn’t think they will win elections without it. item.title: New Mexico prosecutors launch search of Jeffrey Epstein’s secluded former Zorro Ranch
item.description: State investigators have begun searching of a secluded ranch in New Mexico where financier and sex offender Jeffrey Epstein once entertained guests amid allegations that the property may have been used for sexual abuse and sex trafficking of young women. The office of state Attorney General Raúl Torrez on Monday announced the search at Epstein's Zorro Ranch in cooperation with its current owners. item.title: Venezuelan lawmakers open debate on a mining bill to lure foreign capital
item.description: Venezuela’s lawmakers debate a new mining bill that aims to attract foreign investment and rebuild trust after past expropriations. On Monday, acting President Delcy Rodríguez’s proposal reached the legislature. It mirrors parts of a recent oil reform. The bill sets rules for mineral rights and creates small, medium and large mining categories. It also allows independent arbitration, which investors see as protection against future expropriations.
